name: DeepCool LT520 240mm AIO Liquid CPU Cooler Black
shortDescription: DeepCool LT520 240mm AIO Liquid CPU Cooler Black (Multidimensional Infinity Mirror ARGB Pump Block / High Efficiency 3100 RPM Pump / Dual FK120 FDB PWM Fans / 85.85 CFM Airflow / Intel LGA1851 & AMD AM5 Ready / 1-Yea
descriptionHtml:
DeepCool LT520 240mm AIO Liquid CPU Cooler Black (Multidimensional Infinity Mirror ARGB Pump Block / High Efficiency 3100 RPM Pump / Dual FK120 FDB PWM Fans / 85.85 CFM Airflow / Intel LGA1851 & AMD AM5 Ready / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Experience high-performance thermal dissipation and stunning geometric visuals with the DeepCool LT520 240mm AIO Liquid CPU Cooler in Black, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Powered by a potent 4th-generation water pump operating at 3100 RPM with low noise at 19 dB(A), this 240mm liquid cooler features a multidimensional infinity mirror ARGB block cover. Equipped with a 282mm aluminum radiator, 410mm sleeved tubing, and dual high-efficiency FK120 120mm PWM fans utilizing Fluid Dynamic Bearings (FDB), it pushes up to 85.85 CFM airflow and 3.27 mmAq static pressure for extreme cooling on high-end Intel LGA1851/1700 and AMD AM5 processors.
